name: CellFMCount
description: A medical-imaging vision benchmark for automated cell counting on a large immunocytochemistry dataset with extensive manual cell-location annotations, intended to assess counting performance in challenging microscopy images.
evaluation_method: Count accuracy and counting-error metrics such as mean absolute error (MAE), root mean squared error (RMSE), and related detection/counting measures against manual annotations.
notes: Contains 3,023 images and over 430,000 annotated cell locations. The benchmark is recent and the abstract suggests significant difficulty from imaging variability and biological complexity.
